# UAV Companion

> An open-source, static web map of the areas where small drones may fly (or are restricted), starting with Hubei, China, with Singapore planned. It is a planning aid, not flight advice: the official platform for the place (for China, UOM) must be checked before every flight.

People use it to plan drone travel. If a person asks you to prepare waypoints from a travel itinerary, produce a GeoJSON file in the format below. The person pastes your reply into the app (Trips tab, "Plan with an AI"), sees a preview, and confirms. The app checks the flight zones itself, so do not state zones, permissions or legal advice.

## For AI assistants

- [Prompt and format](ai/prompt.md): the exact instructions and an example reply. Follow it. (Paths here are relative to this file.)
- [JSON Schema](ai/schema.json): machine-readable description of the format.
- [Example](ai/example.geojson): a valid reply.

Key rules, in short:
- Reply with one GeoJSON FeatureCollection in a single code block.
- Each Feature has properties.name (required) and optionally type (home, hotel, takeoff, landing, photo, train, airport, hazard, residence, other), note, date and endDate (YYYY-MM-DD with the year; endDate is the last date of a multi-day stay), day (itinerary day, 1 = first) and order (position within the day). date, endDate, day and order are all optional: omit them when unknown, and never guess a year.
- If the whole itinerary is one trip, add a top-level "trip" object ({name, country, startDate, endDate, description}; only name is required). The app creates the trip and puts every place in it except a residence.
- "home" is the drone's home point (where flights start and return to). "residence" is the traveller's own home, only if the itinerary asks for it. Do not confuse them.
- Coordinates are [longitude, latitude] (WGS84), and only when accurate for that exact place. Never estimate or invent them. If unsure, set geometry to null and give properties.query (venue, address, city, country); the app looks it up and marks the result unverified.

## About the data and privacy

- Markers, notes and settings stay in the visitor's browser and are never uploaded.
- Zone data is served as static files; there is no API to call and no account.
